a2-31.title: Communicative Challenge: To the Bakery
a2-31.scenario: Károly phones Meg and asks where she is going. You (Meg) are going to the bakery on the corner, because you like this neighbourhood.
a2-31.prompt: Tell Károly that you are going to the bakery, and that you like this neighbourhood.
a2-31.target: Megyek a pékséghez. Szeretem ezt a szomszédságot.
a2-31.english: I'm going to the bakery. I like this neighbourhood.
a2-31.canDo: I can say I'm going to a place using -hoz/-hez/-höz.

a2-32.title: Communicative Challenge: Close to the River
a2-32.scenario: Károly asks Meg what is near their new flat. The park is close to the river, and the bakery is close to the bridge.
a2-32.prompt: Tell Károly that the park is close to the river and the bakery is close to the bridge.
cues: Say what the park is close to
Say what the bakery is close to
a2-32.target: A park közel van a folyóhoz. A pékség közel van a hídhoz.
a2-32.english: The park is close to the river. The bakery is close to the bridge.
a2-32.canDo: I can say what's close to or far from a place.

a2-33.title: Communicative Challenge: Places in Our District
a2-33.scenario: Károly asks Meg what there is in their district. There is a police station, a theatre and a statue.
a2-33.prompt: Tell Károly that in this district there is a police station, a theatre and a statue too.
cues: Name the three places in this district
a2-33.target: Ebben a negyedben van rendőrség, színház és szobor is.
a2-33.english: In this district there is a police station, a theatre and a statue too.
a2-33.canDo: I can name more places in the city.

a2-34.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Are You?
a2-34.scenario: Károly phones Meg and asks where she is. You (Meg) are coming from the bridge, you are at the bakery now, and you are going on to the church.
a2-34.prompt: Tell Károly where you are coming from, where you are now, and where you are going.
cues: Say where you are coming from
a2-34.target: A hídtól jövök, a pékségnél vagyok, és a templomhoz megyek.
a2-34.english: I'm coming from the bridge, I'm at the bakery, and I'm going to the church.
a2-34.canDo: I can say where I am, where I'm going, and where I'm coming from.

a2-35.title: Communicative Challenge: My Neighbourhood
a2-35.scenario: Károly asks Meg what their neighbourhood is like. It is calm, not busy, and Meg has a favourite bakery on the corner.
a2-35.prompt: Tell Károly that the district is calm and not busy, and that you have a favourite bakery on the corner.
cues: Say where your favourite bakery is
a2-35.target: A negyedünk nyugodt, nem forgalmas. Van egy kedvenc pékségem a sarkon.
a2-35.english: Our district is calm, not busy. I have a favourite bakery on the corner.
a2-35.canDo: I can describe what my neighbourhood is like.

a2-35-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Around the Corner
a2-35-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg where she is. The bakery is close to the bridge; you are coming from the church and going to the bakery.
a2-35-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly that the bakery is close to the bridge, where you are coming from and where you are going.
cues: Say what the bakery is close to
Say where you are coming from and where you are going
a2-35-consolidation.target: A pékség közel van a hídhoz. Most a templomtól jövök, és a pékséghez megyek.
a2-35-consolidation.english: The bakery is close to the bridge. Now I'm coming from the church, and I'm going to the bakery.
a2-35-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about my neighbourhood and the places in it, using -hoz/-hez/-höz.
